metadata.title: 2026 Guideline for Adult Stroke Rehabilitation and Recovery: A Guideline From the American Heart Association and American Stroke Association
top_takeaways: The 2026 AHA/ASA guideline provides updated, evidence-based recommendations spanning the stroke recovery continuum. Key clinical additions emphasize the management of medical comorbidities, fracture risk, fall prevention, technology-enabled rehabilitation, caregiver support, and structured assessments for a safe return to work and driving.
